Source: the review of the AI 问询首页 plan (objectstack `da31daff`, cloud `917f57c`). `AS` = `ui/packages/app-shell/src`.

## T5 — 「设计布局」 adds an "AI 问询" entry (size M, depends on T1 #37787, can start now)
- Files: `AS/layout/DesignModeMenu.tsx`, `AS/layout/designModeMenuModel.ts`, i18n `designMode.menu.kind`.
- Scope: the picker gains 「AI 问询」 as a **singleton** (like "链接", it lists no existing items; once the app has one `ai:chat` entry it is no longer offered). A small form edits title, subtitle, placeholder and suggestions (the T1 `AiChatNavParamsSchema`). "设为首页" = move the item to the first navigation position; do **not** write `landing` (`landing` entries require `visible`, and "same home for everyone" is the first nav item: `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:1603-1611`, :1645-1650).
- Evidence: the picker kinds today are object / view / dashboard / report / page / url (`DesignModeMenu.tsx:990-995`); entries can only be renamed and re-iconed, "who can see it" stays in Studio (`DesignModeMenu.tsx:13-16`, :66-68); `entryFor` has no `component` branch (`designModeMenuModel.ts:330-349`). The save writes the whole app document: the own package when writable, else `.custom` (`AS/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts:5-15`).
- Acceptance: on an installed app the entry saves into `.custom` and is visible to everyone after publish.

## T6 — hide the entry for people with no AI / no seat; home falls through (size S, depends on T2 #37788)
- Scope: someone who cannot get the agent does not see the `ai:chat` item, and the app's home falls to the next nav item instead of an unavailable page.
- Evidence: AI entry points judge per person ("can this person get an agent"), not per deployment (`AS/hooks/useAiSurface.ts:79-97`). `requiresService` (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:451`) covers deployment-level only; no existing per-seat hide mechanism was found — confirm at implementation.
- Acceptance: one case on the community edition (no AI) and one for an account without a seat.

Not mine to notify: #37728 (unblocks #37729) is owned by the epic #37690 seat (repo:cloud#5, claim comment 7206486369; its PR #37799 is ready and over the 3000-line human-merge line). I will send `Notify: landed` for #37787 when PR #37798 merges.
